entry.name: jit.fx.co.screen
entry.description: Blend with a projector screen effect that emphasizes lighter areas.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Adapt output dims to input
attributes.description: Adapt output dims to input (default = 1). When enabled the output dimensions will match the leftmost input dimensions.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.digest: Blend amount (RGBA)
attributes.description: The blend amount for each plane (default = 0 0 0 0). A blend value of 0. results in output values equivalent to the left input, while a value of 1.0 results in output values equivalent to the right input
